summary: Completed backend + frontend regression on NEW preview (/ and /siddha-mala.html), including enquiry flows, auth/admin, CMS, media, responsive checks, and error-path validation.

critical.issue: Delete API allows deletion of any lead; no QA-only guard enforced though requirement says delete ONLY QA leads.

ui_bugs.issue: Console/hydration error: invalid DOM nesting (<span> rendered inside <option>) observed during landing render.

integration_issues.issue: Acceptance check 'canvas pixel nonblank/change with scroll' could not be conclusively validated via 2D readback; WebGL canvas exposes no 2D context in runtime checks.

action_items: Enforce QA-only delete policy in lead deletion logic (or add explicit role/flag gate matching requirement).
Fix invalid option markup generation causing hydration warning in country dropdown rendering path.
Provide deterministic Scene3D verification hook (e.g., test mode canvas snapshot/state telemetry) for nonblank/change assertion.
Re-run full UI regression after above fixes, especially consultation form render and hero motion evidence checks.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth and login lockout controls remain correct: bcrypt $2b$, cookie flags, explicit CORS origin with credentials, and lockout behavior all passed.
Enquiry API now enforces country/country_code consistency and E.164 normalization; idempotent submission_id behavior is working.
CMS validation rules (blank headline, stale revision, unverified stats visibility) correctly return 422/409 as expected.
Media metadata response correctly excludes internal storage fields (_id/storage_path) in public/admin responses.
seed_data_creation: Created QA media fixtures (/app/tests/qa_upload.png, /app/tests/qa_upload.pdf) and temporary QA leads; QA leads were cleaned up after verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL was used throughout. Inline + popup submissions reached /thank-you with name confirmation; popup 503 interception showed no fake success and retry worked. Admin login/logout/guard, lead search/detail/status-note update, CMS section count=21, media upload UI, brochure PDF (200, application/pdf, 9,224,883 bytes), responsive overflow checks at 320/390/768/1024/1440/1920 all executed. Hero tagline was restored to 'One mala. A complete spiritual companion.' and QA leads deleted.
rca of the issue: 1) Lead delete policy gap: backend delete handler performs unconditional delete by id and does not check QA marker/source/flag. 2) Country dropdown hydration warning likely introduced by editor instrumentation/wrapping injecting span nodes in option children at runtime. 3) Scene3D verification gap: WebGL canvas readback path unavailable via 2D context; test cannot prove pixel-change criterion without dedicated observability hook.
